name: Ember Dart
effect: A narrow ember shot; preserves Homura's current bolt and armor exposure.

name: Root Circle
effect: Radial push and one-heart heal with a separate 360-update heal lock; preserves Midori.

name: Gust Fan
effect: Directional projectile clearing and wind-up interruption; preserves Fuuri.

name: Stone Guard
effect: A 36-update one-hit guard and short-range interrupt; preserves Kohaku.

name: Hearthline
effect: Trace three warm floor cells; after a 24-update warning they flare once. No lingering multi-hit stacking.

name: Canopy Knot
effect: Root a target in a small patch for 60 updates and shield the hero from one projectile; does not stack with Stone Guard.

name: Slipstream Loom
effect: Place a 48-update curved air lane; bends hostile shots sideways, without reflecting damage or changing collision.

name: Vaultstep
effect: Plant an arch-shaped shield for 48 updates; hold one additional hit, but forbid attacking during its 12-update root.

name: Dew Ring
effect: Lay a small water ring that slows ordinary enemy movement for 60 updates; bosses are not immobilized.

name: Tide Stitch
effect: Connect two marked pools for a single dash-back rescue; never crosses unmarked walls or story gates.

name: Chime Pin
effect: Send a returning tuning pin that cancels one telegraphed attack; misses have a long recovery.

name: Quiet Orbit
effect: Place three orbiting drops that cancel at most three projectiles over 120 updates; each saved drop becomes one counter-shot on expiry.

name: Threadhold
effect: A narrow Wood tether deals16 Q4 base damage and pulls one ordinary enemy at most8 swept pixels. Bosses cannot be pulled. Only tagged loads can be reeled in field puzzles.

name: Shuttle Span
effect: Set a short visible thread between two authored endpoints for at most60 updates;24 Q4 once per enemy per cast. Every segment and target must have line of sight.

name: Heat Pocket
effect: Place one visible stationary heat patch that bursts after18 updates for24 Q4 once per enemy; maximum lifetime48. Field heat charges affect only tagged receptacles.

name: Firing Drawer
effect: Move a stored heat patch between two short visible positions before its arrival burst,24 Q4 once per enemy. Maximum lifetime60; never crosses unmarked walls or ignites from phase alone.

name: Washback
effect: A short frontal surge deals24 Q4 and pushes ordinary enemies at most10 swept pixels. No boss displacement. Buoy only explicitly tagged dock loads.

name: Wake Turn
effect: A telegraphed L-shaped surge travels at most48 pixels across two orthogonal segments,24 Q4 once per enemy. Check walls on every segment and target; pivot only marked floating loads.

name: Counterdrop
effect: Place a visible small Earth impact that lands after18 updates for24 Q4 once per enemy. Press only authored counterweight pans; manual weights remain a mandatory-route alternative.

name: Counterpoise
effect: One placed weight intercepts one hostile projectile then emits a32 Q4 Earth pulse. Maximum lifetime48; no player invulnerability or healing; normal boss vulnerability still applies.

name: Quarterturn
effect: Redirect one approaching hostile projectile90 degrees into a visible side lane, making it friendly Metal without field or fire tags. Align only marked four-position rail junctions.

name: Gimbal Screen
effect: Place one directional gate for at most48 updates, turning up to two later hostile shots90 degrees. A per-cast projectile ledger forbids repeated redirection; friendly shots are ignored.

name: Leafbound
effect: Brief companion sidestep and narrow lateral Wood cut, 16 Q4 once per target. Swept collision; no player teleport or invulnerability.

name: Canopy Arc
effect: Previewed two-segment curved seed arc, 24 Q4 once per enemy. Bounded path and wall collision; not a stronger straight shot.
